evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 园门 (十八门)、水闸三座
evidence.excerpt_zh: 園内為門十八南曰大宫門曰左右門曰東西夾道門曰東西如意門曰福園門曰西南門曰水閘門曰藻園門東曰東樓門曰鐡門曰明春門曰隨墻門曰蘂珠宫門西曰隨墻門正北曰北樓門為閘三西南為一空進水閘東北為五空出水閘為一空出水閘（圓明園冊）臣等謹按圓明園之水發源玉泉山由西馬厰入進水閘支流派衍至園内日天琳宇桞浪聞鶯諸處之響水口水勢遂分西北高而東南低五空出水閘在明春門北一空出水閘在蘂珠宫北水出苑牆經長春園出七空閘東入清河
evidence.summary: Lists the eighteen garden gates by compass side (大宫門, 福園門, 藻園門, 明春門, 蘂珠宫門, 北樓門 and others) and the three sluices. The note traces the water: in from 玉泉山 Jade Spring Hill by the south-west one-opening inlet, splitting at 日天琳宇 and 桞浪聞鶯, falling from north-west to south-east, out through the five-opening and one-opening sluices and across Changchun Yuan to the seven-opening sluice 七空閘.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
